page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource sharing at the thread level.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high memory-to-core ratio and dedicated physical processor allocation, this server type is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require predictable compute performance. The lack of local storage and GPUs positions it as a specialized option for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines where high memory density and dedicated CPU execution are critical.
